title: US 80 Construction

pageHeader.title: US 80 Construction in Mesquite including I-635 interchange

text: In July 2024 TxDOT awarded a $580.6 million contract to Austin Bridge and Road for reconstruction and expansion of US 80 from Town East Blvd to Belt Line Road, including complete reconstruction of the interchange at Interstate 635. The interchange being replaced was opened in 1970, with a design very similar to five other original interchanges along I-635 and I-20. (The similarly-designed interchange at I-30 was replaced in 2026.)
